annotations.text:
EQUIPMENT TYPES
Barbell, Smith machine and plate-loaded machine all draw the same loaded bar. Only the meta line and the caption differ, because those carry the Base Weight. Colour still only ever means weight.

MIXED UNITS
Stack in lbs, microplate in kg. Two numbers, two units, stacked. Fitty never shows a converted total.

PLATE INVENTORY
On or off per plate size, nothing more. The unit here sets the unit for every barbell, Smith machine and plate-loaded exercise.

UNREACHABLE WEIGHT
The big number stays the Working Weight Fitty tracks. The caption tells you the closest load you can build, with the difference.
